title: Barely Anyone Lives in Northern Canada, Here’s Why.
description:
Hello,


In today’s video, we take a look at the Canadian Shield and how it impacted the population distribution of Canada.

0:00 - Introduction
1:04 - The Canadian Shield
1:44 - The Geology and History of the Canadian Shield
3:55 - The Impact on Population Distribution
4:28 - Mining and Forestry
5:00 - Building on the Canadian Shield
6:17 - Frost Heaving
6:43 - The Layout of Shield Cities
7:45 - Sudbury, ON
8:57 - Thunder Bay, ON
9:53 - Adapting to the Shield
11:10 - The Paradox of the Shield


Cheers,
